etl_logic: SUM(lnst.lnst) FROM index_constituent_snapshot INNER JOIN market_index_snapshot ON index_constituent_snapshot.index_code = market_index_snapshot.market_code AND index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT public_company.equity_ticker_symbol AS symbol, public_company.business_line_level_1_code, SUM(fr_value.data_val) AS lnst FROM public_company INNER JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter IN (1,2,3,4) AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= :etl_date [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC — chốt ĐÚNG 1 báo cáo/kỳ] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id ORDER BY pc_report_submission.rpt_year DESC, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter DESC — quý báo cáo GẦN NHẤT đã công bố tính đến :etl_date] WHERE rn1 = 1 INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCKQKD%' INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '60') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '21')) INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1' WHERE public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' GROUP BY public_company.equity_ticker_symbol, public_company.business_line_level_1_code) lnst ON lnst.symbol = index_constituent_snapshot.symbol GROUP BY market_index_snapshot.market_code
